title: Correlation Between Respiratory Variability of R-R Intervals and Systolic Pressure Variability
brief_summary: This prospective study is designed to assess and quantify the correlation between respiratory changes in R-R interval and the respiratory changed in invasive systolic blood pressure in ventilated patients during changes in posture and peak end expiratory pressure (PEEP) and following a fluid bolus
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-80
* Scheduled for surgery under general anesthesia requiring invasive blood pressure monitoring

Exclusion Criteria:

* Heart Rate other than sinus
* Cardiac Pacemaker Status
* Transplanted Heart
